info.title: Singer Social Media API
info.description: Backend API for the singer social media React Native app (auth + tracks).

post.description: Create a new user account and return access/refresh tokens.
Exchange a refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.

get.description: Return the authenticated user's profile (password omitted).

post.description: Create signed upload URLs for mix and stems (used by backup/sync).

get.description: List the authenticated user's tracks, optionally filtered by status.

post.description: Create a DRAFT track metadata row (LOCAL_ONLY). Audio stays on device until backup.

get.description: Fetch a single track by id (owner only).

patch.description: Update DRAFT track metadata and layers (owner only).

delete.description: Delete a track and its storage files (owner only).

post.description: Signed URLs to upload local mix and stems to Supabase.
Verify uploaded objects and mark track storageState as SYNCED.

get.description: Search users by username or display name. Excludes the authenticated viewer.
Public profile with follower/following counts and relationship flags for the viewer.

post.description: Follow a user. Idempotent if already following.

delete.description: Unfollow a user. Idempotent if not following.

get.description: Return isFollowing / isFollowedBy / isMutual for the viewer vs target user.
List the viewer's recent artist searches (max 20).

post.description: Upsert a recent artist search and trim to the last 20 entries.

delete.description: Delete all recent searches for the authenticated user.
